data.rationale: The proposal follows the same sequence of sites and the same goal, but it leaves out the 8+ review-score hotel filter, the "do not click Reserve/Book/Send" constraints, the Discard step, and the guest count on OpenTable, and it names the activity inputs vaguely (activity_queries, plus a dinner_date and a recipient_email that doesn't specify the {companion}@example.com format), so an automation built from it alone would need guesses.
